title: Compact performance playbook & prep notes
content:
Notes to self — compact performance playbook (quarterly pulse).

Context / purpose:
- Rapid one-page prep for manager syncs and calibration meetings.
- Focus: a) three measurable goals b) quick evidence bullets c) 2 asks for manager and 2 risks + mitigation items.
- Keep short enough to read in 3–4 minutes.

Structure I want to use (template):
- 1-line aspiration / role focus (why this quarter)
- Top 3 outcomes (SMART where possible)
- Evidence log (3–6 bullets of metrics + customer/partner anecdotes)
- Manager priming: what I need from them (2 asks)
- Risks / blockers + mitigation actions (2 items)
- Quick wins and micro experiments (2 things)
- Open questions / decisions to escalate

1-line aspiration / role focus
- Help people ops scale onboarding & performance frameworks so new ICs reach baseline productivity 25% faster while reducing cross-team context switches (focus on onboarding flows, manager coaching, and role clarity).

Top 3 outcomes (Q1 2026)
1) Reduce new hire 90-day ramp time (time-to-contribution metric) from baseline 12 weeks to 9 weeks by end of Q1.
   - Primary metric: % of new hires achieving core onboarding checklist by week 9. Target: 75% (current ~50%).
2) Launch manager coaching pilot with 8 managers, resulting in a 20% uptick in direct reports' engagement survey micro-metrics (clarity & feedback).
   - Measurement: pre/post manager survey + 1:1 pulse scores.
3) Standardize 3 role-play templates + evaluation rubric used in calibration loop to reduce outlier variance by 30%.

Evidence log (measurable + qualitative)
- Onboarding checklist completion rates: Week 4 completion = 62% (baseline from onboarding-dashboard snapshot 2025-12).
- New hire survey comments: recurring friction points: unclear milestones, missing shadow sessions, inconsistent access to infra (3x mentions in last 10 surveys).
- Pilot manager coaching signups: 12 managers expressed interest; capacity for 8 in program one.
- Early manager micro-pulse (n=24 direct reports): clarity score avg 3.1 -> target 3.7.
- Calibration sample review (engineering hires last 6 months): score variance high on 'system design' rubric (stdev 1.4).
- Anecdote: support ticket from Eng-Platform about infra access delay that blocked two new joiners for 6 days (ticket #JIRA-OPS-998).

Manager priming (what I need)
- Ask 1: Sponsor time — I need you to block 2 hours next week with Eng L1 leads to align onboarding milestones and secure shadow sessions.
- Ask 2: Escalation support — when infra access blocks occur escalate to infra-lead with a priority tag; ask manager to commit to stamping the prioritization.

Risks / blockers + mitigation
- Blocker A: Infra access delays (external dependency).
  - Mitigation: short-term: create a checklist that flags infra tickets for expedited handling; owner = infra PO; long-term: add automated provisioning for common account types.
- Blocker B: Manager bandwidth for coaching pilot.
  - Mitigation: limit pilot to 8 managers, provide asynchronous micro-modules (20 minutes) and 1x group coaching session to lower time-cost.

Quick wins and micro experiments (2 wk cadence)
- Micro-experiment 1: Shadow swap 1-week checklist — pair new hire with buddy for dedicated 'ramp hours' (2 hours/day) for first 2 weeks. Measure completion and qualitative score.
- Micro-experiment 2: Office hours for infra provisioning — drop-in slot run by infra on Tuesdays for 6 weeks. Track time-to-resolution.

Evidence snippets to include in sync (pick 3)
- "Week 4 checklist completion at 62% (goal 75%)."
- "Manager pilot interest: 12 expressed, capacity 8 — need to prioritize cohort selection criteria."
- "Infra ticket JIRA-OPS-998 caused 6-day block for two hires — repeat issue across last 3 hiring events."

Conversation scripts / framing (short)
- If manager asks about tradeoffs: "This is a time vs. throughput tradeoff — investing ~6–8 hours of manager time for the pilot should yield 25% faster ramp for new hires, reducing overall cycle cost for the org and decreasing rework."
- If asked about metrics reliability: "We know onboarding-dashboard has sampling noise; for next 6 weeks we'll triangulate with new-hire pulse + buddy reports to improve confidence."

Decisions / asks to escalate
- Approve dedicating 8 manager slots for pilot and a $6k budget for templates + facilitator.
- Approve infra priority tag and standing Tuesday office-hour alignment between infra and people-ops (ops owner: infra PO).

Open questions (to resolve before next sync)
- How do we prioritize managers for the pilot? (criteria proposal: teams with >6 hires in last 12 months OR teams with ramp-time > median).
- Should coaching be mandatory for managers with new hires in their first 90 days? pros/cons.

Personal reflection / growth signal (what I'm tracking about myself)
- Spend more time on fewer, higher-impact cross-team nudges (limit 'yes' to tactical asks unless they map to outcomes).
- Improve data storytelling: practice two-minute framing of metric -> cause -> action.
- Coaching skill: run 3 mock sessions with Amelie before pilot launch.

Archive / follow-ups (next steps)
- Draft pilot cohort criteria doc (due: 2026-01-25) -> link to Confluence (CONFLUENCE-LEADERSHIP-2026).
- Schedule sponsor alignment meeting with Eng L1 leads (target week of Jan 26).
- Build lightweight infra-provisioning checklist and send to infra PO for buy-in (target: Feb 2).

Unresolved / scratch ideas (brainstorm)
- Should we add a "ramp buddy" stipend to incentivize better onboarding? (cost vs. signal).
- Micro-certification for managers after completing 3 coached new-hire cycles.

Quick template (to copy into manager sync):
- Goal headline (1 line)
- 2 metrics (current -> target)
- 2 asks (what I need from you)
- 1 risk + mitigation
- 1 quick win I can run without your time

-- end of note --

(Formatting: keep short bullets; this file is a working compact artifact to copy into meeting notes or into the manager agenda. Will iterate after pilot feedback.)
